```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```
# Functions 

```{r}
separate_canton <- function(df, var) {
  df_long <- df |> 
  mutate(canton = str_extract(week.canton, "[^-]+$")) |> 
  mutate(week = str_extract(week.canton, "^[^-]*-[^-]*")) |> 
  select(-week.canton) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = week, names_from = canton, values_from = var)
}

lags <- function(df, n, var){
  df_lag= df
  for (i in 1:length(colnames(df))) {
    columna = colnames(df)[i]
    if (columna == "week") {
      next
    }
    df_lag[paste(columna, var, "lag", as.character(n), sep = "_")] = lag(df[columna], n)
    df_lag <- df_lag |> 
      select(-columna)
  }
  return(df_lag)
}

week_canton_fun <- function(df) {
  df_wk <- df |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(df)) |> 
  mutate(canton = str_extract(name, "^[^_]+")) |> 
  mutate(var = str_extract(name, "(?<=^[^_]{0,100}_).*")) |> 
  mutate(week_canton = paste(week, canton, sep = "-")) |> 
  select(week_canton, var, value) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = week_canton, names_from = var, values_from = value)
  
  return(df_wk)
}

calculate_lags <- function(df, var, n) {
  df_lags <- week_canton_fun(lags(separate_canton(df, var), n, var))
  return(df_lags)
}
```

# Casos 

```{r}
casos <- read.csv(r"(C:\Users\nan\OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica\cuenta personal\ucr pers\practica profesional\practica dengue\dengue-model\data\clean\casos_dengue.csv)")
```

```{r}
casos_long <- separate_canton(casos, "casos") |> 
  select(-c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "98", "99"))
```

```{r}
casos_lag_1 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 1, "casos"))
casos_lag_2 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 2, "casos"))
casos_lag_3 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 3, "casos"))
casos_lag_4 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 4, "casos"))
casos_lag_5 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 5, "casos"))
casos_lag_6 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 6, "casos"))
casos_lag_7 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 7, "casos"))
casos_lag_8 <- week_canton_fun(lags(casos_long, 8, "casos"))
```

```{r}
casos_lags <- casos_lag_8 |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_7, by = "week_canton") |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_6, by = "week_canton") |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_5, by = "week_canton") |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_4, by = "week_canton") |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_3, by = "week_canton") |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_2, by = "week_canton") |> 
  left_join(casos_lag_1, by = "week_canton")
```

```{r}
write.csv(casos_lags, r"(C:\Users\nan\OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica\cuenta personal\ucr pers\practica profesional\practica dengue\dengue-model\data\clean\lags\casos_dengue_lags.csv)")
```
